title: BUG: duplicate indexing with embedded non-orderables

labels.name: Indexing
labels.description: Related to indexing on series/frames, not to indexes themselves

body:

```python
 for user_id, row in pending_data_df.iterrows():

        df = DataFrame(
            columns=[

            index=[user_id]
```
